held_list.headline: Because of AI, 52% of students with elevated depressive symptoms who used a generative-AI coaching app for six weeks improved meaningfully, against 32% given care as usual.
Because of AI, the Hurricane Center called a Category 5 landfall in Jamaica about three days out, while Melissa was still a Category 1.
Because of AI, Oman screened 43,000 diabetics for retinopathy, flagged 12,000 for treatment, and cut specialist waiting lists by 87%.

Because of AI, specialist consultations at two hospitals in western China took 3.14 minutes instead of 4.41 when patients first gave their history to a chatbot, and patients rated communication easier.

leads_added: Generative AI and maternal health outcomes in pregnant and postpartum individuals: a randomized clinical trial (Rosie chatbot). [JAMA Netw Open](https://doi.org/10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2026.41062) (2026-11-04; full text at https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamanetworkopen/fullarticle/2856248). Measured null for `not-because`: 400 participants, 1:1 against a book-club control, 12-month GAD-7 and PHQ-9 differences not significant (per a WebFetch summary, unverified). Missing: verbatim quotes from the full text (`npm run read` returns HTTP 403, so the gate may not read it either), exact absolute figures, and trial dates from the methods. Try Europe PMC or the registry record for a readable primary source.

ALERT-PA, electronic alert for primary aldosteronism testing. [NCT05925569](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05925569) (results posted 2026-11-03, cluster-randomized, 2024-03-13 to 2024-12-09). Likely a rule-based EHR best-practice alert, not AI; probably outside scope. Missing: evidence that any AI is involved.

AI documentation in human services, randomized field experiment. [AEARCTR-0018700](https://www.socialscienceregistry.org/trials/18700) (in development, 2026-04-29 to 2028-12-01). Protocol to watch. Missing: results, achieved dates.

Skipped: protocols (physical-education mHealth, AI-delivered CBT for diabetes), a physician-incentives registration for 2028, systematic reviews and meta-analyses, retrospective model validations and simulations, commentary, and ERIC education items already seen.
